create_ai4animation_standalone: create an AI4Animation instance in STANDALONE mode with a custom program and profiler
create_ai4animation_headless: create an AI4Animation instance in HEADLESS mode that runs an infinite update loop
run_ai4animation_update: run the AI4Animation Update method to advance time and call program and scene updates
run_ai4animation_draw: run the AI4Animation Draw method to render the program and scene visuals
run_ai4animation_gui: run the AI4Animation GUI method to render the program and scene interface elements
